text_en: Jacob settled in the land where his father had lived as an alien, the land of Canaan.
text_cn: 雅各伯定居在他父亲作客的客纳罕地方。

text_en: This is the story of the family of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was shepherding the flock with his brothers; he was a helper to the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father’s wives; and Joseph brought a bad report of them to their father.
text_cn: 以下是雅各伯的小史。若瑟十七岁时，与哥哥们一同放羊。他尚年幼，常与自己的父亲的妻子彼耳哈和齐耳帕的儿子们在一起。他不断将他们作的恶事报告给父亲。

text_en: Now Israel loved Joseph more than any other of his children, because he was the son of his old age; and he had made him a long robe with sleeves.
text_cn: 以色列爱若瑟超过其他的儿子，因为是他年老生的，并给他做了一件彩色长衫。

text_en: But when his brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably to him.
text_cn: 他的哥哥们见父亲爱他胜过其余的儿子，就忌恨他，不能与他和气交谈。

text_en: Once Joseph had a dream, and when he told it to his brothers, they hated him even more.
text_cn: 若瑟作了一梦，讲给哥哥们听，因此他们越发恼恨他。

text_en: He said to them, “Listen to this dream that I dreamed.
text_cn: 他对他们说：“请听我作的梦：

text_en: There we were, binding sheaves in the field. Suddenly my sheaf rose and stood upright; then your sheaves gathered around it, and bowed down to my sheaf. ”
text_cn: 我梦见我们同在田中捆麦子，忽然我的麦捆站起来，你们的麦捆围住我的麦捆下拜。”

text_en: His brothers said to him, “Are you indeed to reign over us? Are you indeed to have dominion over us? ” So they hated him even more because of his dreams and his words.
text_cn: 他哥哥们对他说：“难道你要作我们的君王？或者统治我们？”他们为了这梦和这番话，越发恼恨他。

text_en: He had another dream, and told it to his brothers, saying, “Look, I have had another dream: the sun, the moon, and eleven stars were bowing down to me. ”
text_cn: 他又作了一梦，也告诉他哥哥们说：“我又作了一梦：梦见太阳和月亮并十一颗星辰向我下拜。”

text_en: But when he told it to his father and to his brothers, his father rebuked him, and said to him, “What kind of dream is this that you have had? Shall we indeed come, I and your mother and your brothers, and bow to the ground before you? ”
text_cn: 当他给父亲和哥哥们讲说这梦时，他父亲就责斥他说：“你作的是什么梦？难道我和你母亲以及你的兄弟，都要来向你叩首至地？”

text_en: So his brothers were jealous of him, but his father kept the matter in mind.
text_cn: 他兄弟们都忌恨他；他父亲却将这事存在心里。

text_en: Now his brothers went to pasture their father’s flock near Shechem.
text_cn: 若瑟的哥哥们去了舍根，放他们父亲的羊。

text_en: And Israel said to Joseph, “Are not your brothers pasturing the flock at Shechem? Come, I will send you to them. ” He answered, “Here I am. ”
text_cn: 以色列对若瑟说：“你哥哥们不是在舍根放羊么？来，我打发你去看看他们。”他回答说：“我在这里。”

text_en: So he said to him, “Go now, see if it is well with your brothers and with the flock; and bring word back to me. ” So he sent him from the valley of Hebron. He came to Shechem,
text_cn: 以色列对他说：“你去看看你哥哥们是否平安，羊群怎样；然后回来告诉我。”以色列便打发他由赫贝龙山谷前去；他到了舍根。

text_en: and a man found him wandering in the fields; the man asked him, “What are you seeking? ”
text_cn: 有一个人见他在田间游荡，那人就问他说：“你寻找什么？”

text_en: “I am seeking my brothers, ” he said; “tell me, please, where they are pasturing the flock. ”
text_cn: 他答说：“我寻找我的哥哥；请告诉我：他们在哪里放羊？”

text_en: The man said, “They have gone away, for I heard them say, ‘Let us go to Dothan. ’” So Joseph went after his brothers, and found them at Dothan.
text_cn: 那人答说：“他们已离开了这里；我听见他们说：我们到多堂去。”于是若瑟便去追寻他的哥哥，在多堂找到了。

text_en: They saw him from a distance, and before he came near to them, they conspired to kill him.
text_cn: 他们老远就看见了他；在他尚未来近以前，就已决定要谋杀他。

text_en: They said to one another, “Here comes this dreamer.
text_cn: 他们彼此说：“看，那作梦的人来了！

text_en: Come now, let us kill him and throw him into one of the pits; then we shall say that a wild animal has devoured him, and we shall see what will become of his dreams. ”
text_cn: 我们杀掉他，将他抛在一口井里，说是猛兽吃了。看他的梦还有什么用？”

text_en: But when Reuben heard it, he delivered him out of their hands, saying, “Let us not take his life. ”
text_cn: 勒乌本听了，就设法由他们手中救他，遂说：“我们不要害他！”

text_en: Reuben said to them, “Shed no blood; throw him into this pit here in the wilderness, but lay no hand on him”—that he might rescue him out of their hand and restore him to his father.
text_cn: 勒乌本又对他们说：“你们不要流血；只将他丢在这旷野的井里，不可下手害他。”他的意思是想由他们手中救出他来，还给父亲。

text_en: So when Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped him of his robe, the long robe with sleeves that he wore;
text_cn: 若瑟一来到他哥哥们那里，他们就脱去了他穿的那件彩色长衣，抓住他，把他丢在井里；

text_en: and they took him and threw him into a pit. The pit was empty; there was no water in it.
text_cn: 那井是空的，里面没有水。

text_en: Then they sat down to eat; and looking up they saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, with their camels carrying gum, balm, and resin, on their way to carry it down to Egypt.
text_cn: 他们坐下吃饭时，举目看见一队由基耳阿得来的依市玛耳人；他们的骆驼满载树胶、香液和香料，要下到埃及去。

text_en: Then Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?
text_cn: 犹大遂对兄弟们说：“杀害我们的弟弟，隐瞒他的血，究竟有什么益处？

text_en: Come, let us sell him to the Ishmaelites, and not lay our hands on him, for he is our brother, our own flesh. ” And his brothers agreed.
text_cn: 不如将他卖给依市玛耳人，免得对他下毒手，因为他究竟是我们的兄弟，是我们的骨肉。”兄弟们听从了他的意见。

text_en: When some Midianite traders passed by, they drew Joseph up, lifting him out of the pit, and sold him to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. And they took Joseph to Egypt.
text_cn: 米德杨的商人经过那里时，他们便从井中拉出若瑟来，以二十块银钱卖给了依市玛耳人；他们便将若瑟带到埃及去了。

text_en: When Reuben returned to the pit and saw that Joseph was not in the pit, he tore his clothes.
text_cn: 勒乌本回到井边，不见若瑟在井内，遂撕裂了自己的衣服，

text_en: He returned to his brothers, and said, “The boy is gone; and I, where can I turn? ”
text_cn: 回到兄弟们那里喊说：“孩子不见了！我可往哪里去呢？”

text_en: Then they took Joseph’s robe, slaughtered a goat, and dipped the robe in the blood.
text_cn: 他们于是拿了若瑟的长衣，杀了一只公山羊，将长衣浸在血里；

text_en: They had the long robe with sleeves taken to their father, and they said, “This we have found; see now whether it is your son’s robe or not. ”
text_cn: 然后派人将那件彩色的长衣送给他们的父亲说：“这是我们寻得的，请你仔细看看，是不是你儿子的长衣？”

text_en: He recognized it, and said, “It is my son’s robe! A wild animal has devoured him; Joseph is without doubt torn to pieces. ”
text_cn: 雅各伯仔细一看，就喊说：“是我儿子的长衣；猛兽将他吃了。若瑟被撕裂了，被撕裂了！”

text_en: Then Jacob tore his garments, and put sackcloth on his loins, and mourned for his son many days.
text_cn: 雅各伯遂撕裂了自己的衣服，腰间围上麻衣，为自己的儿子悲哀了多日。

text_en: All his sons and all his daughters sought to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted, and said, “No, I shall go down to Sheol to my son, mourning. ” Thus his father bewailed him.
text_cn: 虽然他的儿女都来安慰他，他却不肯接受他们的安慰，说：“我只有悲哀地下到阴间，往我儿那里去！”他的父亲竟这样哀悼他。

text_en: Meanwhile the Midianites had sold him in Egypt to Potiphar, one of Pharaoh’s officials, the captain of the guard.
text_cn: 米德杨人后来在埃及将若瑟卖给了法郎的内臣，卫队长普提法尔。
